overview.faq01Q: How long does a typical project take?
overview.faq01A: Most projects run 6–16 weeks from kickoff. We give you a timeline before you sign anything.
overview.faq02Q: Do you work with international clients?
overview.faq02A: Yes. Most of our communication is async and in English or French. Calls are scheduled around your timezone.
overview.faq03A: Fixed-price per project. We scope carefully upfront so there are no surprises.
overview.faq04A: Yes — maintenance contracts available. Most clients keep us on for 6-12 months post-launch.
overview.faq05Q: Can you take over an existing codebase?
overview.faq05A: Sometimes. We do a paid 1-week audit first so we can give you an honest answer about what it'll take.

About.subhead: A small team of senior engineers building honest software from Tetouan, Morocco.
About.storyHeadline: Five years of shipping software that lasts.
About.storyBody: Bangicode was founded in 2020 by Ahmed Chioua, a full-stack engineer who wanted to build a studio that treats clients the way he'd want to be treated — fixed prices, honest timelines, and code he'd be happy to maintain five years later. We've grown to 12 people across four practices: custom software, e-commerce, technical training, and social presence. Every project starts with a 30-minute call and ends with clean documentation.
About.val01Body: Every project is led by a senior engineer. No juniors billing as seniors, no offshore surprises.
About.val02Body: Fixed-scope, fixed-price. We scope carefully upfront — then we deliver what we said, when we said.
About.val03Body: We write code we'd be happy to maintain in three years. Documentation, tests, clean architecture.
About.teamBody: Based in Tetouan, Morocco. Serving clients across Morocco, France, and the MENA region.

Process.h1: From hello to kickoff in two weeks or less.
Process.subhead: A four-step process designed to move fast without surprises.
Process.step01Body: Fill out a short form or message us on WhatsApp. No RFPs, no decks, no NDAs required to have a first conversation. Just tell us what you're building and roughly what you need.
Process.step01Detail01: Short intake form or WhatsApp message
Process.step01Detail02: No NDA required at this stage
Process.step01Detail03: We reply within one business day
Process.step02Body: Ahmed (or a lead engineer from the relevant practice) gets on a 30-minute video call with you. We ask questions, you ask questions. We're trying to understand the problem space — not sell you anything.
Process.step02Detail01: 30-minute video call with a senior engineer
Process.step02Detail02: We scope what's in / out of the project
Process.step02Detail03: We tell you honestly if we're not the right fit
Process.step03Body: We write a fixed-price proposal that covers the full scope, timeline, team, and tech stack. No hourly billing, no retainers, no vague "we'll figure it out as we go." You know exactly what you're paying and when you'll receive it.
Process.step03Detail02: Full scope, timeline, and team breakdown
Process.step03Detail03: We present and walk you through it on a call
Process.step04Body: Once the proposal is signed, we start the first sprint within two weeks. You get a private Slack channel, a shared Notion workspace, and weekly demo calls for the duration of the project. No radio silence.
Process.step04Detail01: Private Slack channel for async comms
Process.step04Detail02: Shared Notion workspace — always up to date
Process.step04Detail03: Weekly demo calls throughout the project
Process.prin01Body: We scope every project carefully before agreeing to a price. If the scope changes, we renegotiate — but we never surprise you with an invoice you didn't expect.
Process.prin02Body: Most of our communication is written and async. You don't need to be available for daily standups. Weekly demos give you a reliable pulse without the overhead.
Process.prin03Body: Everything we build belongs to you. Full source code, full deployment access, no lock-in. We hand over clean docs and stay available for support.

Careers.subhead: We're a small, deliberate team based in Tetouan. We build software, run training, and grow brands — for clients across Morocco and beyond.
Careers.hire01Body: No formal application — just a short message about who you are, what you build, and why Bangicode. We read every one.
Careers.hire02Body: If there's mutual interest, we'll have a 30-minute call. No trick questions, no whiteboard puzzles. We want to understand how you think.
Careers.hire03Body: For technical roles, we run a short paid project — a real task from our backlog. You get a feel for us; we get a feel for you.
Careers.work01Body: Every project goes to production. You'll own features end-to-end — spec, build, deploy, and watch it land with real users.
Careers.work02Body: Our training practice means you'll often pair with clients to build their own capability — not just hand over a deliverable.
Careers.work03Body: We don't have separate silos. A developer here knows the product, talks to the client, and writes the docs.
Careers.work04Body: We pick problems where our work has lasting effect — platforms clients operate for years, not quick launches that disappear.
Careers.rolesEmpty: We don't have open roles at the moment, but we keep a small bench. If you'd be a fit for software, e-commerce, training, or social work — say hi.
Careers.ctaBody: Send us a note. If you're the right fit, we'll find a way to work together.
